notes:
High-level: Mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics + in-app guidance). Evaluating Redwood Hosted first to get a rapid prototype live, then plan to move to Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation. Use cases: embeddings for search/rerank, chat assistant in app, summarization of customer logs.

Call highlights: - 2026-02-18 intro (Jordan/Jordan): product roadmap includes in-app assistant by Q3. Wants predictable p50 latency ~200-400ms for short chat completions, peak throughput for 2k MAU projected ~8-12 qps. Cost sensitivity high — engineering has tight unit economics targets.
- Quote from Head of Product: "We can't trade 3x cost for marginal quality gains. Show us how batching + caching saves money without hurting UX."

Eval plan / POC: - Phase 1: Hosted API demo + integration prototype (embeddings & simple chat) — completed 2026-02-25. - Phase 2: Cost-optimization workshop with Redwood (batching, prefix/KV caching, quantization profiles, request routing) — scheduled 2026-03-18. Outcome: workshop runbook + cost model. - Phase 3: Short Dedicated POC (2-week reserved pool) to validate latency SLOs and failover routing.

Technical constraints: - Prefer open/Redwood-verified models, need quantized variants (INT8/4bit) for cost targets. - KV caching for multi-turn chat to reduce token counts — must work with current UX where we store last 3 turns. - Routing: want fallback to cheaper quantized model for non-critical paths. - Security: SSO (SAML), SOC2 compliance mandatory, KMS for key custody, audit logs retained 12 months, some EU-residency requirement for event logs.

Commercial / procurement notes: - Interested in a committed Dedicated package if POC proves unit economics; initial ARR target $75k-$180k. - Pricing discussion: request for model-specific per-token pricing comparisons (hosted vs dedicated blended) and a proposal showing break-even point for different batching configurations.

Risks / open items: - Need quantization perf numbers for their specific prompts (legal/HR domain). Redwood asked to provide sample-run token reports. - Security questionnaire still in review (sent 2026-03-01). - Budget approval expected early-April; procurement cycle could slip revenue to next quarter.

Suggested AE playbook: 1) Run cost workshop with Engineering + Finance (cover batching simulations, caching impact, quantization quality tradeoffs). 2) Provide a POC runbook and cost model template. 3) Ship a small dedicated pilot with clear pass/fail (latency & unit cost).
